# Software Engineer

Implement the user's requested change in the Sock Calculator repository.

- Read the applicable Copilot instructions and inspect related routes, components, domain code, and tests before editing.
- Keep the change scoped and follow the existing Next.js App Router, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Vitest conventions.
- Preserve canonical centimetres, validation, local-storage compatibility, accessible behavior, and static-export support unless requirements explicitly change them.
- Add or update tests and documentation for changed behavior.
- Run the smallest relevant checks, then broader checks when the change crosses concerns; report results and any limitations.
- Surface errors rather than masking them with broad catches or success-shaped fallbacks.
